verdict.rationale: Clerk's changelog announces Admin Logs, an audit trail of admin actions across the Dashboard workspace, which covers the admin-activity part of the story; its documented webhooks emit user lifecycle events (e.g. user created/updated) rather than a dedicated authentication audit stream. A community report of being unable to trace who changed a console setting may predate the Admin Logs launch and lowers confidence. Missing for 10: audit logging of authentication events (sign-ins, MFA, failures), any tamper-evidence or integrity guarantees, documented SIEM streaming or log export (e.g. log drains or Splunk/Datadog integrations), detailed Admin Logs documentation, independent corroboration that Admin Logs works.
